questions.stem: Which of the following correctly describes the state of bromine at room temperature?
questions.explanation: Bromine is a red-brown liquid at room temperature. It is the only non-metal that is liquid at room temperature. Fluorine and chlorine are gases, while iodine is a grey-black solid. Going down Group 7, melting and boiling points increase.

questions.stem: Why can iodine not displace bromine from sodium bromide solution?

options.text: Iodine is a solid and cannot dissolve
Iodine is less reactive than bromine and cannot displace it
Iodine and bromine are in different groups

questions.explanation: Iodine is below bromine in Group 7 and is therefore less reactive. A less reactive halogen cannot displace a more reactive one from its compounds. Only a more reactive halogen can displace a less reactive one, so iodine cannot displace bromine.
